children.description: Defines the content which is shown inside the `SplitterElement`.
children.x-typescriptType: string | number | boolean | ReactElement<any, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Array<ReactNode>

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

minSize.description: Defines the minimum size of the `SplitterElement`. The resizer element stops when the minimum size is reached.

resizable.description:
Defines whether a resizer element is displayed.

If the next `SplitterElement` has the prop `resizable={false}`, no resizer element will be shown after this
`SplitterElement`. The resizer element is only shown when all siblings of the resizer are resizable.
Default value of resizable is `true`.

size.description:
Defines the initial size of the `SplitterElement`.

__Note:__ In order to preserve the intended design, at least one `SplitterElement` should have a dynamic `size`.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.
